replays.text:
**It could be a good fit if you want a portable projector setup—not a conventional video screen.** TravelPlay is a clip-on screen that doubles as a sunshade, with rear-seat, tailgate, and panoramic-roof viewing modes. It folds into a carry bag and is designed for use with the Aurzen ZIP or another compatible portable projector, so you’ll need to supply the projector too.

**Check your Model Y year:** Aurzen says it’s designed for the **2025–2026 Model Y Refresh**; fit on earlier versions may vary. Projection is for use only while the car is stationary, and Aurzen says to make sure the clips are securely installed.

You can [buy it from Aurzen’s U.S. store](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y), listed at **$119.99**. The listing says it’s available in the U.S. only.
